title: Cross-check: E2 (4h OHLC) vs the simulator desk (1m replay), Krown S8 4h, BTCUSDT, 2026-10-28

what.name: Rule (both paths)
what.value_plain: Krown S8 squeeze break on 4h BTCUSDT; market entry at the next 4h open; stop at the far side of the last 10 bars; target 2R; time stop after 100 bars
what.label: OURS

what.name: Detector S8 basis and lookback
what.value_plain: BBWP basis 7, lookback 100, break above the 50th percentile
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Mismatch threshold
what.value_plain: 0.05 R net difference per matched trade
what.label: OURS

how: Two code paths run on the same 4h S8 signals: E2 simulates on 4h candles, the desk replays every trade on 1m candles. Trades are joined on entry bar and side; each gap is compared and traced to one of eight known differences, and each difference is removed in turn to confirm it.
window: DEV only, signals 2022-04-01 to 2024-06-30, BTCUSDT; no bar at or after 2024-07-01 loaded
why: Signals: 122 of 122 common; the detector and the 1m-to-4h resample reproduce E2's signals.
Trades: 70 of 71 matched; the unmatched pair is one cascade from a target level that differs by 0.018 R on average.
Net R: mean absolute difference 0.0062 R, max 0.0198 R; no matched trade differs by more than 0.05 R; exit kind agrees on 70 of 70.
With the target level and the slippage placement aligned the paths agree to 2e-16 R.
Mechanics only: the E2 edge verdict stays INCONCLUSIVE.
